h1: Thai cooking class on Koh Lanta
lead: A morning at the market, then four dishes you cook yourself with a local cook: a starter, a soup and two mains with curry paste made from scratch. Then you eat it all.

legacyText.title: Thai Cooking Class Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: The class is held in a cooking school on Koh Lanta. The morning class runs on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays from 9:00 to 14:00, market visit first. You leave with your apron, a recipe booklet, a certificate and a box for what you could not finish.
The school also teaches fruit and vegetable carving, with your creations to take home, on weekday mornings or afternoons depending on the day.
legacyText.cardDescription: A visit to the local market, then cook Thai dishes with a local cook. Suitable for children.
goodToKnow: Morning class on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays. Evening class on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays, from 16:00 to 21:00.
Carving class: Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays from 15:00 to 18:00, Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays from 9:00 to 12:00.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. The morning and evening cooking classes cost the same.
